cases.name: the `is not None` filter on the verdict set is dropped
cases.old: verdict = {f.case for f in findings if f.case is not None} | set(agreed_by_name)
cases.new: verdict = {f.case for f in findings} | set(agreed_by_name)
cases.expect_survivor: equivalent, not uncaught. The filter removes `None` from a set that is only ever asked `name not in verdict` for a `name` out of CASES, and no case is called None. It is kept because `tally` filters the same way one line over, where it does matter — `len(broken)` would be one too many — and two lines reading differently would invite somebody to make tally's match this one.

cases.expect_survivor: unreachable from the unit suite, which calls `silent_cases` directly and never runs `main`. Reaching it needs three adapters and a server, which is what `examples/explorer/run.sh --conformance` is; nothing that fits in `check.sh` drives `main` at all.
